purpose: Introduce a DEV-only independent action-authorization policy that does not trust model safe_to_act self-attestation as sufficient authorization.

background.e10h_blocker: E10h concluded that post-hoc visible-output self-consistency guards did not generalize because self-attested action safety was treated as sufficient authorization.
background.e10g_full_result: E10g full matched E10d/E10e full and retained premature_action_rate=0.25.
background.e10f_dev_result: E10f showed that simply making visible thresholds stricter can preserve safety but collapse action/decision quality.
background.e10g_dev_result: E10g restored DEV quality but did not solve the full safety blocker.

measurement_rules: Run DEV only before any new full DEV+VALIDATION measurement.
Do not tune on VALIDATION before, during, or after this DEV-only gate.

Do not expose private expected paths, evaluator labels, reference trajectories, validation feedback, docs/test-scenarios.md, data/cases.parquet, eval/expected-paths.json, or LOCKED_TEST to the model or policy.
Score with E9 v3 only after fixed outputs are generated.
Commit only sanitized aggregate summaries and reports.
